units.name: Professional Practice in IT
units.description: Develop professional skills, ethical awareness and workplace practices for IT.
units.content: Students develop an understanding of professional standards, communication, teamwork and ethical responsibilities required within contemporary IT workplaces.

units.name: Introduction to Programming
units.description: Introduces fundamental programming concepts, problem solving and computational thinking.
units.content: This unit introduces programming fundamentals and provides students with a foundation for developing software solutions using structured problem-solving techniques.

units.name: Object-Oriented Development
units.description: Explores object-oriented programming principles, design and software development practices.
units.content: Students explore object-oriented concepts including classes, objects, inheritance and abstraction while developing maintainable software solutions.

units.name: Mobile Application Development
units.description: Covers principles and techniques for designing and developing mobile applications.
units.content: The unit introduces mobile application development concepts and considers user experience, application architecture and development practices.

units.name: Mobile and Web Technologies
units.description: Examines technologies and development approaches used to create modern web and mobile solutions.
units.content: Students investigate technologies used to develop contemporary web and mobile applications, with attention to responsive design and modern development practices.
